tools.name: search_campers
tools.description: Search active camper listings on VanAuto (vanauto.pl). Use segment "sale" for campers for sale and "rental" for camper rentals. Returns compact rows with price, specs, city and a link to the listing page. All listing text is in Polish. Prices are in PLN; for rentals, priceMin/priceMax filter the daily/per-period rental rate.

query.description: Free-text search over the listing title and description.

make.description: Camper make, e.g. "Adria", "Fiat", "Benimar". Use list_camper_makes to resolve names.

priceMin.description: Minimum price in PLN (sale price, or rental rate per period).

priceMax.description: Maximum price in PLN (sale price, or rental rate per period).

city.description: City name in Polish, e.g. "Wrocław", "Kraków". Matched against the city catalog.

availableFrom.description: Rental only: earliest pickup date (ISO, e.g. 2026-07-01).

availableTo.description: Rental only: latest return date (ISO, e.g. 2026-07-14).

sort.description: Sort order. Rental supports newest, price_asc, price_desc only.

after.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call (nextCursor) to fetch the next page.

tools.name: get_camper_details
tools.description: Get full details for one camper listing by slug (listing page id) or camper id (cam_...). With a slug, searches sale listings first, then rentals; set segment to force "sale" or "rental". With camper_id, returns the camper spec sheet from the full catalog. Includes decoded specs, photo URLs, equipment, contact details and the listing URL. Set includePhotos to also attach actual camper photos as images so you can look at them.

slug.description: Listing slug from search results, e.g. citroen-jumper-ba12fa.

camperId.description: Camper public id, e.g. cam_4aJ62weNfqbS (from search results).

segment.description: Which listing space the slug belongs to.

maxDescriptionChars.description: Description is truncated to this many characters.

includePhotos.description: Attach camper photos as images (400px thumbnails) the model can actually see.

photoLimit.description: How many photos to attach when includePhotos is true.

tools.name: list_camper_makes
tools.description: List camper makes (brands) known to VanAuto with how many active sale and rental listings each has. Use this to resolve a brand name before searching.

query.description: Optional substring filter, e.g. "ben" for Benimar.

tools.name: list_camper_equipment
tools.description: List the camper equipment catalog grouped by category. Equipment names are English identifiers used in listing filters and camper specs.

tools.name: get_camper_market_stats
tools.description: Current VanAuto market snapshot: active sale and rental listing counts, campers by body type, and makes with active inventory.

tools.name: analyze_camper_prices
tools.description: Market price statistics for a cohort of active sale listings: min, max, average, median, p25/p75 and counts, plus average price by production year. Optionally pass a listing slug (slug) to see how that listing compares to the cohort (percentile and deviation from median). Use this to answer "is this a good price?".

make.description: Cohort make, e.g. "Adria". Use list_camper_makes to resolve names.

yearMin.description: Earliest production year in the cohort.

yearMax.description: Latest production year in the cohort.

slug.description: Sale listing slug to compare against the cohort.

maxSample.description: Maximum listings to sample for statistics.

tools.name: find_similar_campers
tools.description: Find sale listings similar to a given one (same market segment, price bracket and specs). Returns compact rows for the alternatives the platform suggests.

slug.description: Sale listing slug from search results.

tools.name: get_rental_reviews
tools.description: Published customer reviews for a rental listing (id from search results, e.g. rls_...). Returns ratings and review text. Sale listings do not have reviews.

rentalListingId.description: Rental listing id from search results, e.g. rls_A50UmVqECBDt.

tools.name: search_marketplace_listings
tools.description: Search the VanAuto marketplace (akcesoria - camper parts and accessories). Supports text, manufacturer, category, condition, compatibility and price filters. Returns compact rows plus facets with category/condition counts.

query.description: Free-text search over title and description.

location.description: City name or postal code text filter.

tools.name: get_marketplace_listing_details
tools.description: Get full details for one marketplace (akcesoria) listing by slug: price, condition, shipping, compatibility, seller, photos and links. Optionally includes related offers and the seller's other listings.

slug.description: Marketplace listing slug from search results.

includeRelated.description: Include related and seller's other listings.

maxDescriptionChars.description: Description is truncated to this many characters.

tools.name: get_marketplace_seller
tools.description: Marketplace seller profile by id (from a marketplace listing's seller): display name, verification and trust badges, ratings and reputation, plus their active offers.

includeListings.description: Include the seller's active marketplace listings.

tools.name: search_wanted_ads
tools.description: Search marketplace wanted ads (kupię / poszukuję) posted by buyers looking for camper parts and accessories. Supports text, category and subcategory filters.

query.description: Free-text search over title, description, manufacturer and part number.
